fields.statement: QA at 1bfa91e9d, scratch build (go build -trimpath) driving a real ship-change conduct step in a scratch repo with a fake claude, 4 leaves (par,a,b,c): {"findings":[]} refused exit 2 naming 'leaves par, a, b, c', 'nothing was journaled' (round count unchanged); finding on a + evidence for b only refused naming 'par, c'; finding with no leaf + b,c evidence refused naming a; unknown leaf zzz, blank line, missing leaf, extra field, evidence as object all usage exit 2; evidence:null treated as none and refused; finding a + evidence b,c,par accepted; leaf by full ID, multiple lines per leaf and stdin '-' accepted; evidence journaled on the round. go test ./internal/api -run 'RunStatus|CheckRound|RunFindings|Coverage|Evidence' and ./internal/run/... pass.
